description: A dark, stormy night at sea. A ship's stern edge is lit by warm lanterns, and a large grooved wheel or drum with a thick dark cable wound on it sits at the right. A heavy cable with a bulging cylindrical casing hangs off the side and runs down into churning, white-capped waves. Four or five crew in dark oilskins and sou'westers work the rails and handle long poles. A faint figure stands on an upper deck at the top right. No visible text, no frame.
